body.p: (task 0.1). CMake 3.24+, Ninja. Presets: debug (Clang, ASan + UBSan), debug-gcc, (default compiler), msvc (Visual Studio 2022, Windows only), wasm (cmake/wasi-sdk.cmake, wrapping the SDK's wasi-sdk-p1.cmake; SDK from WASI_SDK_PREFIX or /opt/wasi-sdk; WASI SDK 34 in CI). Build trees go to build/<preset>.

item.p: One library target sxml, static by default; -DSXML_BUILD_SHARED=ON builds it shared. Public functions are marked SXML_EXPORT (include/sxml/export.h); project code has hidden visibility.
sxml_apply_project_flags(target) applies C17 and the guideline flags (MSVC: /W4 /WX) to project targets only; sxml_apply_third_party_flags builds vendored and generated code as C11 with warnings off.
Sanitizers (SXML_ENABLE_SANITIZERS) apply to every target, third-party included, so instrumentation sees all memory accesses.
Each public header is compiled alone, twice included, by the sxml_header_check target (self-containment and include guard).
WASI test executables run under Node.js (tools/run-wasi.mjs, set as CMAKE_CROSSCOMPILING_EMULATOR), so ctest --preset wasm runs the tests.
sxml_version_text returns a NUL-terminated string: an external boundary.
